list: Official 55 trophies as published on Exophase (PSN), frozen 2026-11-18

trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.guide: This is the platinum itself. It unlocks automatically the moment the other 54 trophies are all earned, so never chase it directly — work the roadmap steps in order and treat this as the finish line. If it does not pop, open the checklist and look for any trophy still unticked; the platinum only fires when the count reaches 54 of 54. Sources: Exophase official PSN list for name, description and grade (https://www.exophase.com/game/grand-theft-auto-vi-psn/trophies/); PSNProfiles trophy page for grade and any tracked count (https://psnprofiles.com/trophies/43531-grand-theft-auto-vi); guide text is my own wording written for this entry from the official description only — no other guide's text was copied.

trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
trophies.guide: Play the opening mission, Gone Fishing, from a new game and finish it without skipping the ending sequence. It is the first story beat, so it cannot be avoided: follow the on-screen prompts, complete the fishing introduction and let the mission-complete banner play. trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.guide: Reach 100% on the in-game completion counter — this gold is the long tail of the platinum. Use the game's own completion checklist: story, stranger strands, activities, collectibles and exploration all feed it. In this tracker, tick trophies as you earn them; when only this and the platinum remain, the missing percentage is whatever the in-game list still shows open. trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.guide: Complete 250 stunts in total. Stunt jumps and stunt events both feed counts like this in the official description's wording, so repeat the shortest stunt you find reliable and batch them in free roam rather than hunting a new one each time. trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Earn gold in every Shooting Range challenge — 42 challenges per the official list's tracked count. trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: At VCIA (the airport), make a departure that is not scheduled — in plain terms, take off or leave in a way the airport does not intend.
